purpose: Result-blind paired NSESche-only training test of an exact current response-time expert after the complete V186 QPR failure.

diagnostic_evidence.conclusion: V186 slightly improved throughput and cost but increased latency, with cold-start wait the dominant common-request stage regression. The next axis must optimize current response time explicitly rather than alter load normalization.

mechanistic_hypothesis.single_intervention: At operational queue density at least 8 only, replace the frozen pure OCS operational penalty by deterministic three-vote Borda: two votes rank candidates by exact current response-time proxy and one vote ranks candidates by the exact frozen V184 OCS-P score. The response-time proxy is parent transfer time plus immutable cold-start frames when no warm container exists plus exact pending immutable CPU work, runnable remaining CPU work, same-window projected immutable CPU work, and the current player's immutable CPU work divided by node CPU capacity.
mechanistic_hypothesis.why_two_response_votes_are_principled: QPR is throughput divided by latency and cost. V186 already preserved throughput and improved cost; the measured deficit was latency, dominated by cold starts. A two-to-one response-time majority directly targets that causal component while retaining OCS as a deterministic locality and memory expert.
mechanistic_hypothesis.fallback: If any required parent-transfer, function-profile, CPU-work, remaining-work, projected-assignment, bandwidth, or CPU-capacity input is unavailable or invalid, use the exact frozen V184 OCS penalty for that player across all candidates.

paired_control.purpose: Measure the intervention on the same newly captured tapes without running any non-NSESche baseline.

cohort.fixed_counterbalanced_order: For even numeric seeds run control then candidate; for odd numeric seeds run candidate then control.
cohort.reference_action: Build or bind policy-independent references through the fail-closed dependency rules for all forty run specifications.

disposition.on_pass: Freeze the candidate as training winner and preregister a later disjoint NSESche-only confirmation cohort; do not claim low closure from E1610-E1629.
disposition.on_fail: Retain all forty runs, seal a failure receipt, close this response-time axis, and continue first-principles diagnosis without advancing to middle.
